target.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Web-search credential presence detection mixed ordinary provider options with real credentials. It could count non-credential fields as configured credentials while missing credential-equivalent plugin config such as SearXNG `baseUrl` and explicit keyless providers.

## Why This Change Was Made

The detector now only counts direct or scoped `apiKey` values under `tools.web.search`, applies consistent SecretRef/env semantics, checks plugin `webSearch` credentials including `baseUrl`, and treats manifest-declared bundled providers with `requiresCredential: false` as configured when explicitly selected.

## User Impact

Security/audit and setup paths get fewer false positives from non-credential search options and fewer false negatives for explicitly selected keyless web-search providers. No live provider key is needed for the regression proof.

## Evidence

- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/openclaw-vitest-cache-web-search-rebase node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
- `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` on `src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.ts` and `src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Proof

The local config matrix covers direct credentials, unresolved and resolved env SecretRefs, legacy env SecretRef strings, non-env SecretRefs, plugin `webSearch.apiKey`, plugin `webSearch.baseUrl`, explicit keyless providers, explicit credentialed providers without keys, unknown providers, and public artifact probe failures.
